scope: Only the 15 listed final PNGs were opened with view_image and independently inspected as raw RGB PNGs. Existing title-layout and run JSON were read. No browser, GPU, product-code changes or test runs were performed for this review.
conclusion: No blocking visual defect found in these images.
observations: The original greatsword, axe, shield and two maneuver action icons remain distinct at their actual UI scale. Both Korean maneuver labels and their remappable Shift+P / Shift+O key hints are readable.
The actual disarm targeting screen displays 40% and energy cost 12, with target brackets and confirmation/cancel instructions.

After greatsword equipment the axe and shield are visible in the bag. The recovered revolver shows the actual ! 1/6 loaded-and-jammed badge. The PNG review corroborates visible state; item identity and rule outcomes are verified by the separate existing whole-world checks.
At 1366x768 both maneuver buttons stay on one HUD navigation row with all ten quick slots, and the inventory remains within the viewport.
The reaver is dark under the actual fixture lighting, while the final corpse original art is visible. This review does not change or classify the existing light/visibility rules as an art defect.

Both common title layouts show the original art and complete start button at scroll zero. The recorded start button bottoms are 880.28125 at 1440x1080 and 714.28125 at 1366x768, with center hit tests true.

Some view_image previews appeared partially black, but the original RGB PNG regions contain the status, tools, sidebars, inventory and log pixels. These preview artifacts are not classified as product defects.

raw_png_check.method: For each non-title PNG, count RGB pixels with max(channel) > 36 in fixed panel regions. These counts distinguish image-preview omissions from the original PNG pixels; they are supporting evidence rather than semantic UI tests.
raw_png_check.note: The inventory region may contain world/aim pixels when the inventory is closed; title images have no panel-region counts.
